findings.title: Dark subscription: GymFlow
findings.rationale: Charged $29.00 every ~30 days (6 times) but only 0 uses logged in the last 90 days. Cancelling saves ~$29.00/mo.

findings.title: Penalty fee from Card Penalty (Fees)
findings.rationale: 1 penalty charge(s) totaling $15.00. One-off — often refundable on first offense.

findings.title: Duplicate charge: StreamVibe
findings.rationale: $13.49 charged on 2026-07-09 and again on 2026-07-10 (1 day(s) apart). Refundable via merchant dispute.

findings.title: Recurring fees from State Bank (Fees)
findings.rationale: 6 fee charges totaling $29.70 (~$4.95/month). Bank fee waivers are commonly available on request.

findings.title: Silent price hike: Spotify
findings.rationale: Last 2 bills are $12.99 vs previous ~$9.99 (+30%) with no notice on the statements. Consider a plan downgrade or renegotiation.
